device.type: Compact DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with built-in Wi-Fi, Conax / MultiCAS card reader and USB PVR
device.board: 2A000A00 (bootloader version "3510CA 1.1.1", 8 MB SPI flash, single-CPU ALi M3510C / C3503C platform)
device.soc: ALi M3510C / C3503C (single-CPU 64 MB DDR2 DVB-S2 SoC reading chip ID 0x3503 rev 0xC000)

source.note: Archive AMIKO_Mira_1.1.89_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots on C3503 (chips/c3503.py) (run_dump_mira_1189_emu_app_starts.py, run_dump_mira_1189_emu_capture_screen.py) and renders its 1280x720 OSD on GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko Mira Wi-Fi (System ID 2A000A00, v1.1.89 EMU) firmware (2017-12-07) on a 8 MB SPI flash for ALi M3510C / C3503C (single-CPU 64 MB DDR2 DVB-S2 SoC reading chip ID 0x3503 rev 0xC000).
